F1 (redact-then-query) surfaced 2 NEW P1 DEFECTS invisible from source review alone - exactly why live evidence was required, not a source-review substitute: BUG-1 (P1): authenticate.webhook() normalizes topic (shop/redact -> SHOP_REDACT) but a DB CHECK constraint expects the literal 'shop/redact' string - a correctly-HMAC-signed live webhook request returns 500 on ALL FOUR webhook routes, not just shop/redact. BUG-2 (P1): shop-redact.service.ts calls sessionStorageInstance.deleteSessions([]) unconditionally; the session-storage library builds 'WHERE id IN ()' with no empty-array guard, causing a Postgres syntax error that rolls back the ENTIRE redact transaction. Since app/uninstalled (fires immediately on uninstall) already deletes all sessions, and shop/redact fires ~48h later per the designed lifecycle, EVERY REAL SHOP following the normal uninstall path hits this crash - GDPR hard-deletion currently cannot complete for any real merchant. BUG-3 (P3, note): webhook_event's ON DELETE CASCADE deletes the in-flight row anyway when shop is deleted, making the code's 'mark processed_at, do not delete' comment dead/inaccurate (harmless side effect: it does produce the literal zero-rows FT-08 wants, by accident not design). NO SOURCE FIXES applied (no-auto-fix rule) - awaiting explicit human fix command per project rules. Gate remains BLOCKED, now for defects found rather than missing infrastructure - infrastructure blocker is CLEARED. | BUG-1 + BUG-2 FIXED, commit 6f5525affa752b9646fd9e91e0094abcb3fedead. A real install on any store needs a public HTTPS tunnel via `shopify app dev`. FRESH LIVE EVIDENCE (dev-evidence/g4-sprint-1.1-live-evidence-v2/): correctly-signed shop/redact webhook with a shop that has ZERO sessions (the exact prior-crash case) -> 200 (was 500), drained successfully, compliance_audit_log outcome=completed, all 6 tenant tables 1->0. NEW FINDING (not fixed, not authorized): app-uninstalled.service.ts has the IDENTICAL unguarded deleteSessions([]) pattern BUG-2 fixed elsewhere - not triggered live yet, found by code reading, flagged for human fix-decision (see next audit entry). | QA RE-VERIFICATION (independent, not trusting developer self-report): BUG-1 and BUG-2 CONFIRMED GENUINELY FIXED via direct source read of all 4 webhook routes + shop-redact.service.ts AND cross-referenced live-evidence-v2 (200 replacing 500, zero-session-shop redaction completes with full 1->0 deletion across all 6 tenant tables). NEW P1 CONFIRMED TRUE by independent read: BUG-4 in app-uninstalled.service.ts - identical unguarded deleteSessions([]) pattern, CONFIRMED WORSE than BUG-2 because drain-worker.ts dispatches handleAppUninstalled WITHOUT the shared claim transaction shop-redact uses, so markShopUninstalled can commit independently before deleteSessions throws, leaving a half-committed state + a webhook_event row retrying forever. Gate remains BLOCKED - cannot PASS with an open P1 (QA rule 1), even though the two originally authorized bugs are verified closed. details.new_conflict_raised: Human proposed deploying to Vercel (free account, already connected to the above repo on Vercel's side). This directly contradicts ADR-0001 (G1.5-confirmed hosting decision), which named Vercel specifically as part of the rejected class - Vercel has no always-on process model, and the durable webhook-inbox drain-worker + 45-day GDPR sweeper (ADR-0002/0008), just verified working live via 2 rounds of bug-fixing, depend on a continuously-running process that would not run on Vercel. Orchestrator did NOT silently comply or silently refuse - flagged the concrete technical conflict and asked the human to explicitly choose: (a) formally override ADR-0001 and have the architect redesign the drain/sweeper mechanism around Vercel Cron Functions, or (b) use an always-on host for the app and Vercel for something else. Also noted no free tier survives ADR-0001's own disqualification of sleeping free tiers - the $0-budget constraint genuinely collides with the always-on-for-GDPR-reliability requirement.
details.gate_impact: Does not block current G4-sprint-1.1 BUG-4 decision (unrelated). Would require a G1.5 REVISE/RENEGOTIATE or a logged human override if Vercel is chosen, before any deploy work is delegated to shopify-developer.
